content: Task management views: Kanban (columns by stage, drag-drop, WIP limits, bottleneck detection, continuous/flowing work). List (rows+columns, filtering/sorting, dense data, daily execution, comparing records). Timeline/Gantt (horizontal time axis, dependencies, deadline-driven projects). Calendar (time-bound deliverables). Best practice: offer multiple views on same data, instant switching, single source of truth. Enterprise: limit visible items 6-12, consistent row heights, clear visual hierarchy, don't force one view for all work types.
